fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Never written; zero in every save
fields.evidence: diff blank/formatted/real saves all zero

fields.name: signature
fields.meaning: Fixed text ' sweet-and-sour ' marking the memory as formatted. Checked at every power-on: missing means the whole 32 KB is cleared and the signature rewritten
fields.evidence: code f000:30d4 (compare f000:30f5, clear f000:3126, write f000:313b); diff blank->formatted; boot reads f000:30f7

fields.name: file 1 marker
fields.meaning: Text 'CHONGARA' written when file 1 is saved; the file counts as present only if this marker and the checksum both match
fields.evidence: code f000:31a0 (write op 1 f000:322e, check op 0 f000:31d8); marker table ROM f000:32ca; diff empty->saved; boot read f000:31da

fields.name: location
fields.meaning: Map the party is on: high byte = area, low byte = room (0x0702 in the real save, the bedroom). The area picks the place name in the file list and field menu
fields.evidence: code d000:47e5 writes it on map change, 8000:bed2 maps it to a place-name number; list name matches; diff

fields.name: unknown (word after location)
fields.meaning: Always 0; no code is known to read it
fields.evidence: new-game init writes 0 (f000:0c20/b000:41fa)

fields.name: current music
fields.meaning: Number of the music track now playing (0x0c in the real save); stored right before the music driver is restarted
fields.evidence: code f000:8c61 stores it then calls f000:8ef4; callers: new game, map enter, battle, events

fields.name: story flags (probably)
fields.meaning: Nearly all zero; one byte (0x35 = f0) set in real saves. Probably story/event progress flags
fields.evidence: diff blank->real save (single byte set)

fields.name: three 3-byte entries
fields.meaning: Table of three 3-byte entries; the game searches the first byte of each for an id (0 = free). All zero in real saves
fields.evidence: code f000:3496 and f000:34b7 search it

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Zero in real saves
fields.evidence: diff

fields.name: unknown (ff ff ff)
fields.meaning: 0xFFFF + 0xFF written at new game; no reader found
fields.evidence: code f000:0c20/b000:41fa defaults

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Zero in real saves
fields.evidence: diff

fields.name: extra-block flag
fields.meaning: When set, the 56-byte block at 055e-0595 is copied along with the file-list entry
fields.evidence: code b000:3773 copies the block when non-zero, b000:498a writes 0/1

fields.name: timer step
fields.meaning: Step subtracted from on-screen actor timers every tick (0x0100 default)
fields.evidence: code f000:69f6/6a25/6bb3/6bf1 subtract it from timer fields

fields.name: window colour
fields.meaning: Colour of message/menu windows as 12-bit colour (0x666 grey default); written into the palette whenever windows are drawn
fields.evidence: code f000:755d copies it into the window palette; new-game default

fields.name: flags
fields.meaning: Bit flags; bit 2 switches menu behaviour (save menu and item list test it). 0 in real saves
fields.evidence: code b000:498a/b000:571a/b000:b1b5 test bit 2

fields.name: display select (probably)
fields.meaning: 7 at new game, 1 in the real save; read when drawing the party panels
fields.evidence: code f000:0c20 default; read b000:433b

fields.name: party
fields.meaning: The three party slots, each a character record number 0-7 (0xFFFF = empty). Real save: one member. The list shows these characters' level/HP/MP
fields.evidence: code b000:3773/b000:9d38 read it; new game sets 0,2,1

fields.name: item counts
fields.meaning: Owned count (0-99) of each item id; adding caps at 99, removing at 0 also unlists the id. Real save: item 215 x2 (item 248 holds 215, above the cap, so high ids may be flags instead)
fields.evidence: code b000:0397 get, b000:03a3 add (cap 99), b000:040b remove; shop/menu display; value range in real save

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Zero in real saves; no code references found
fields.evidence: diff

fields.name: money high
fields.meaning: High part of the money 0-9999; value = high*1000 + low, max 9,999,999 (0 in the real save)
fields.evidence: code b000:e192 add, b000:e208 spend, b000:e26a 7-digit display

fields.name: money low
fields.meaning: Low part of the money 0-999

fields.name: play time: hours
fields.meaning: Hours of play time (list shows HH:MM)
fields.evidence: code b000:e12a counter; list 00:11 matches

fields.name: play time: minutes
fields.meaning: Minutes 0-59
fields.evidence: code b000:e12a; list 00:11

fields.name: play time: seconds
fields.meaning: Seconds 0-59
fields.evidence: code b000:e12a

fields.name: play time: 1/76 s
fields.meaning: Frame ticks within the second, 0-75
fields.evidence: code b000:e12a (wraps after 75); differs between back-to-back saves

fields.name: party tile X
fields.meaning: Party column on the map in 24-pixel tiles
fields.evidence: code e000:2fbe (pixel X / 24)

fields.name: party tile Y
fields.meaning: Party row on the map in 24-pixel tiles
fields.evidence: code e000:2fbe ((pixel Y - 1) / 24)

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Zero; no code references found
fields.evidence: diff

fields.name: map-entry variant
fields.meaning: Entry-spot variant 0-5 copied in when a map is entered; picks the spot on maps with several entries (written as a word, high byte overlaps record 0 byte +0)
fields.evidence: code d000:1134 writes from RAM 0F81; map 0x2300 switch in e000:2fbe

fields.name: character records
fields.meaning: Eight 86-byte records (0x56 each), character n at 02ac + n*0x56. Record 0 is the hero; the rest hold earlier companions. Rows below give offsets inside one record
fields.evidence: code b000:3773/b000:9d38 (index*0x56 + RAM 0a84); shared tail pattern

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Zero
fields.evidence: diff

fields.name: extra block
fields.meaning: 56-byte block copied with the file-list entry when the flag at 00a5 is set; zero in real saves
fields.evidence: code b000:3773 copies RAM 0d36-0d6d when flag set

fields.name: file 1 checksum
fields.meaning: 16-bit plain sum of bytes 0020-0595 (marker + data); recomputed 0x5b88 on the real save
fields.evidence: code f000:32fa sum, f000:3255 write, f000:31f9 check; recomputed on 3 real saves

fields.name: file 2
fields.meaning: Same layout as file 1 shifted by 0x578; marker 'DIECBECK'
fields.evidence: code f000:31a0 tables f000:32ea/32f2; real save in slot 2 verified

fields.name: file 3
fields.meaning: Same layout as file 1 shifted by 0xaf0; marker 'TEO(^o^)'
fields.evidence: code f000:31a0 tables; real save in slot 3 verified

fields.name: suspend record
fields.meaning: Marker '.SHANTE.' + 0x683 data bytes (the file data plus 0x115 more, RAM 0d6e-0e82) + 16-bit byte-sum at 1713. The title offers Continue when it verifies and no file does. No writer found in disassembled code
fields.evidence: code f000:31a0 slot 3, title check d000:6824; never written in observed play

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Never written
fields.evidence: diff all saves zero; no routine addresses it

fields.name: signature copy
fields.meaning: Second copy of ' sweet-and-sour '. First copy good but this one bad stops the game at power-on
fields.evidence: code f000:3111 compare (mismatch loops f000:3115), f000:3150 write; diff

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Never written
fields.evidence: diff

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Not used for saves: identical to blank in every save
fields.evidence: diff blank/real saves identical
